## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure path.
- [ ] Default tests do not require provider credentials or live campaigns.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are fictional and sanitized.
- [ ] New code or data has compatible provenance and attribution.
- [ ] User-facing documentation matches the implementation.
